shape.appetite: Small: five separable PRs on existing seams (axis plan, PlannedAxes, numericScale, axisDrag, Axes tab). No new chart types or renderer rewrites.
shape.problem: Bounds clip silently; log is listed but unavailable outside ECDF; four chart types rescale on brush, breaking the stable-axes rule.
shape.recommended_shape: One hidden-rows marker per axis side with a reason (bound or nonpositive), count in the chart's unit, and a one-side Reset; stable all-row domains on aggregate bars, series bars, row charts, and line values; true log on scatter, line values, and box plots via logAxes().
success_moves: Put the marker in AxisPlan.hidden so every chart reports and one component draws.
Reuse the marker for log's nonpositive warning instead of a second indicator.
Prove the marker on scatter first, where exclusions and all-row domains already exist.
Gate log with logAxes() so saved 'log' on ineligible charts stays linear and rollback is one line.
Keep box statistics on all values and clip at the floor, so log stays view-only.
Split stable aggregate axes into its own PR because it changes existing behavior.

first_proof.question: Does a marker at the clipped axis end read clearly and get noticed?
first_proof.artifact: Scatter on the shop demo with an x maximum set; marker, count, and one-side Reset.
first_proof.observation: Icon noticed at the axis end; count matches rows beyond the bound; Reset restores the axis at 1280 and 390 px.
first_proof.decision_rule: Clear → extend to other charts. Missed or crowding ticks → move beside the axis title first.

rabbit_holes: Marker placement colliding with tick labels and drag grips.

milestones.title: Scatter says when a bound hides rows
milestones.proof: Shop demo scatter with x max: marker, correct count, one-side Reset; browser at 1280/783/390 and dark.
milestones.outcome: Scatter shows a hidden-rows marker with count and one-side Reset.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Other charts unchanged; scatter bounds work as before plus the marker.
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; AxisPlan.hidden is optional, so charts that omit it draw no marker.
evidence: vitest: scatterPlan, axisBounds, hiddenNotice panel tests (58 pass)

Playwright on shop demo at 1280, 783, 390 px and dark: marker, count with field formatting, hover into details, one-side Reset; press and drag on the marker leave 500 of 500 rows while a control drag brushes to 129

milestones.title: Every bounded chart shows the marker
milestones.proof: Bar, histogram, row, line, box show counts in their unit only when bounded.
milestones.outcome: All six bounded charts report hidden marks in their own unit.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Each chart either fills hidden or draws no marker.
milestones.rollback: Stop filling hidden in a chart's plan.
evidence: hiddenNoticeCharts.test.tsx: count bars, histogram rows, row bars, box rows, numeric line rows and points, time-series points
Playwright on shop demo: histogram x bound (1280, 783) and aggregate bar y bound (1280, 390); counts, unchanged row totals after clicking the marker, no tick overlap, reset

milestones.title: Aggregate charts keep stable axes
milestones.proof: Brushing in flights leaves bar, row, and line axes still.
milestones.outcome: Aggregate bars, series bars, and time-series values keep all-row domains under brushing and grow to fit filtered values past them.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Marks follow filters; axes do not.
milestones.rollback: Revert per chart; each plan keeps its live aggregate for marks.
evidence: stableAxes.test.tsx: four cases fail without the change and pass with it
Playwright on shop demo: brushing the scatter to 56 of 500 rows left every chart's axis domains unchanged
Row charts already sized from all-row totals (rowChartPlan.ts); the plan's earlier claim was wrong

milestones.title: True log on scatter
milestones.proof: Flights log delay axis with nonpositive warning; drag and bounds in log space.
milestones.outcome: Scatter offers true log with a nonpositive warning.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Log offered only where logAxes() allows; other charts linear.
milestones.rollback: Remove scatter from logAxes(); saved log then draws linear.
evidence: Playwright: shop scatter switched to log through settings at 1280 and 390 (decade ticks, drag pans in log space, no console errors); flights hexbin with marginals and fit shows warnings for 16,821 X and 15,248 Y rows
